name: Primal Defense
body:
Your instincts and sheer determination are all you need to ward off attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When unarmored, you add your Constitution bonus to your AC and your CMD. This does not stack with class features that allow you to add your Wisdom bonus or any other ability score other than Dexterity to your AC. If you are proficient with shields, you can use a shield to further improve your AC while using this feat.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
